name: [UPD] Build a Noob Kingdom
desc:
👑 Welcome to Build a Noob Kingdom! 👑
Build your very own kingdom in this sandbox tycoon!
Place down houses for Noobs to move in, create job opportunities to earn cash, and construct military stations to conquer the map!

🌱 How to Play 🛠️
• Housing: Build homes to grow your Noob population! 🏠
• Economy: Give your Noobs jobs to produce Gold automatically! 💸
• Military: Train an army and unlock powerful units! ⚔️
• Conquer: Capture up to 11 Points around the map for huge boosts! 🚩

💾 Your progress saves automatically!
⏰ Your builders continue working even when you are offline!
🤝 Ally with friends to rule the server!

Expand your kingdom and become the best! 🏰
